fields.v: Partly (0.5): mixed-effects models with 95% CIs and p-values per contrast and equal-weight per-problem robustness analyses handle problem variability, but each problem-language-model combination is run once (sampling at temperature 1.0), so run-to-run variability is not measured
fields.quote: To conserve tokens and budget, we instead randomly sample 100 tasks (yielding 2,000 sessions), and we refer to this subset as MiniLCB.
fields.why: Only one session per problem, language and model (2,000 sessions = 100 x 4 x 5) with stochastic sampling, so repetition-based variability is absent and the statistics only address problem difficulty.
fields.doubt: Cada problema/linguagem/modelo corre só uma vez (2.000 sessões = 100 x 4 x 5), com temperatura 1.0. A análise estatística controla a dificuldade do problema, mas não a variação entre execuções. Decide se Q8 fica Sim ou passa a Parcial; tu próprio anotaste 'single run'.
